from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Literal

# The 9 fixed cause categories derived from the task description
CauseCategory = Literal[
    '行政行为 - 行政受理',
    '渎职罪',
    '所有权纠纷',
    '执行案由 - 其他案由',
    '知识产权与竞争纠纷',
    '执行案由 - 先予执行',
    '行政行为 - 行政补偿',
    '行政行为 - 行政撤销',
    '行政主体 - 行政检查（监察）'
]

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Information extracted from a single judgment document relevant to cause classification."""
    title: str = Field(description="The actual title of the judgment document (e.g., '《判决文书 1》')")
    cause_category: CauseCategory = Field(description="The specific legal cause category assigned to this document")
    dispute_focus: str | None = Field(description="A short description of the core legal dispute or subject matter")
    legal_provision: str | None = Field(description="Key legal provisions or laws cited that determine the cause")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt from the document supporting the classification")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Aggregates extracted information from all documents to enable classification and grouping."""
    documents: list[DocumentInfo]
